items.title: Williams-Sonoma Sinks 14% as Q3 Falls Just Short of Estimates and Full-Year Outlook Stays Put
items.summary: Key TakeawaysWilliams-Sonoma fell 14% after its third-quarter results came in just below estimates and it only reiterated its fiscal 2026 outlook. Excluding a one-time tariff refund, gross margin barely moved as higher oil prices raised supply-chain costs.
